record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: Assume that N = 2 vertex operator superalgebras corresponding to Calabi-Yau manifolds have been constructed, that the basic representation-theoretic results for those algebras have been obtained, and that the full N = 2 superconformal field theories have been constructed. Under those assumptions, formulate and prove physicists’ conjectures on Calabi-Yau manifolds, such as quantum cohomology and mirror symmetry, by turning physicists’ intuition into mathematical methods using those results and constructions.

evidence.quote: Problem 8.3. Suppose thatN = 2 vertex operator superalgebras corresponding to Calabi-Yau manidfolds can be constructed, that the basic results in the representa- tion theory of these algebras can be obtained and that the full N = 2 superconformal ﬁeld theories can be constructed. Formulate and prove the conjectures (for example, quantum cohomology and mirror symmetry) by physicists on Calabi-Yau manifolds by turning physicists’ intuition into mathematical methods using these results and constructions.

artifact.category_tag: N=2 vertex operator superalgebras and mirror symmetry
artifact.self_contained_problem:
Working under the following hypotheses:

(i) For every Calabi-Yau manifold $X$ (a compact Kähler manifold with trivial canonical bundle), there is an associated $N=2$ vertex operator superalgebra $V_X$ — that is, a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-graded vertex algebra equipped with two odd fields $G^\pm(z)$ and a $U(1)$-current $J(z)$ satisfying the $N=2$ superconformal algebra relations, whose construction reflects the geometry of $X$.

(ii) The basic representation theory of such algebras $V_X$ is available: classification of irreducible modules, fusion rules, modular invariance of characters, and the structure of the associated modular tensor category.

(iii) From $V_X$ one can construct a full $N=2$ superconformal field theory (a consistent collection of correlation functions on Riemann surfaces of all genera, satisfying the sewing axioms and modular invariance).

Under (i)–(iii), give a mathematically rigorous formulation, and a proof, of the standard physical conjectures attached to Calabi-Yau manifolds in terms of the data of $V_X$ and its associated superconformal field theory. In particular:

(a) Express and prove the quantum cohomology of $X$ — the deformation of the cup product on $H^*(X)$ by genus-zero Gromov-Witten invariants — in terms of correlation functions of chiral primary fields of $V_X$.

(b) Formulate mirror symmetry as a precise equivalence between the $N=2$ superconformal field theories associated to a mirror pair $(X, X^\vee)$ of Calabi-Yau manifolds (interchanging the A-model and B-model twists, equivalently the chiral and antichiral rings, and exchanging $H^{p,q}(X)$ with $H^{n-p,q}(X^\vee)$), and prove this equivalence using the constructions in (i)–(iii).
artifact.status_search_result: A full mathematical proof of mirror symmetry and the construction of quantum cohomology purely via N=2 vertex operator superalgebras associated to Calabi-Yau manifolds remains an open program. Partial progress exists (e.g., chiral de Rham complex, Borisov's lattice vertex algebra approach to toric mirror symmetry, Costello–Li's work on BCOV and B-model, and proofs of the mirror theorem by Givental and Lian–Liu–Yau in the Gromov–Witten setting), but a unified VOA-based formulation and proof as stated has not been achieved.

status_evidence.title: Vertex algebras and mirror symmetry (Borisov)
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs lattice vertex algebras associated with reflexive polytopes and proves a vertex-algebraic version of mirror symmetry for toric Calabi-Yau hypersurfaces.
status_evidence.claim: Partial VOA-based mirror symmetry results exist in the toric case but not the general case.

status_evidence.title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
status_evidence.snippet: Lists, as an open problem, the rigorous derivation of physicists' Calabi-Yau conjectures (quantum cohomology, mirror symmetry) from N=2 VOSAs and full SCFTs.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as open.
